pdfUrls.title: PDF URLs
pdfUrls.description: Direct links to PDF files. Duplicate URLs are processed once.

datasetId.title: Or take PDF URLs from a dataset
datasetId.description: For example the output of a scraper run. Use together with "URL field".

urlField.title: URL field in that dataset
urlField.description: Field holding the PDF URL or an array of URLs. Dotted paths work, e.g. "documents.pdf".

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Which pages to extract, e.g. "1-3,7,10-". Empty = all pages.

maxPagesPerPdf.title: Maximum pages per PDF
maxPagesPerPdf.description: Longer documents are cut and marked with truncated: true.

includeFullText.title: Include full text
includeFullText.description: All selected pages joined in one "text" field.

includePages.title: Include text per page
includePages.description: A "pages" array with { page, text } for each page.

password.title: Password (for protected PDFs)
password.description: Used for every PDF in this run.

concurrency.title: Parallel downloads
concurrency.description: How many PDFs to download and read at the same time.
